$comment: Upstream changes held back for the owner's decision by the weekly upstream sync (scripts/personal/upstream-sync.ps1). Each entry was reverted after the merge (holdBy=revert, revertCommit set) or kept on our side (holdBy=keep_ours). To ship one: git revert <revertCommit> (or undo the pin), then remove the entry.

held.whatChanged: Upstream moves node-pty from ^1.1.0 to 1.2.0-beta.15, only to get a linux-arm64 prebuild. Bots runs on Windows x64 and copies node-pty into each release, so it keeps ^1.1.0 (apps/server/package.json and pnpm-lock.yaml, our side of the 1.47.0 hand merge). No code in the batch needs the beta: NodePtyAdapter.ts is unchanged.
options: Keep node-pty ^1.1.0 (Windows x64 needs nothing from the beta)
Take 1.2.0-beta.15 after checking terminals on a staged release
held.recommendation: Keep ^1.1.0 until upstream ships a stable 1.2.x or merged code needs it.

held.area: pnpm-workspace overrides and the Hermes source-map patch
held.whatChanged: Upstream's Expo 58 catalog overrides pin @expo/metro-config, @expo/dom-webview and expo-constants globally. apps/hbots-mobile stays on Expo 57 in phase 1, so those three overrides are removed and each app resolves its own toolchain. The Hermes source-map patch trunk carried on metro-config 57.0.12 is carried at 57.0.13, the version the Expo 57 range resolves, because 57.0.13 does not contain the fix.
options: Keep hbots-mobile on Expo 57 with its own toolchain and patch (phase 1)
Move to Expo 58 with the rest of the platform bump (phase 2)
held.recommendation: Keep the split until the phase 2 platform bump moves apps/hbots-mobile to Expo 58, then restore the global overrides and the 58 patch only.

held.whatChanged: Upstream moves playwright-core from 1.60.0 to 1.64.1. The bots' shared browser runs on the Chromium installed for 1.60.0 and each release copies playwright-core, so apps/server keeps 1.60.0.
options: Keep playwright-core 1.60.0 (the installed browser matches it)
Take 1.64.1 together with a browser install and a staged check of the shared browser
held.recommendation: Keep 1.60.0 until a release plans the browser install and checks the shared browser on a stage.

held.whatChanged: Upstream added its own mise ownership (resolveMiseProviderMaintenance, `mise upgrade`). The fork's mise ownership (install @latest, latest link, rollback list) still decides for every mise path; upstream's resolver only sees non-mise paths.
options: Move to upstream's mise resolver after a staged provider update and rollback
held.recommendation: Keep the fork's until a release tests upstream's resolver on a stage with a real update and rollback.

held.whatChanged: Upstream lists each kind of banked reset as a redeemable option. The fork keeps its own kinds summary and single Use reset flow; the contract carries both shapes.
options: Keep the fork's reset credit flow
held.recommendation: Keep the fork's flow; a redeem spends a real credit, so a change here needs the owner.

$acceptedComment: Decisions the owner has already answered. A key listed here is settled: ship that upstream change like any other improvement, never hold it and never ask again. Remove an entry only if the owner changes his mind.

accepted.decision: Take upstream's rich-text composer default (Tiptap, formatting and list continuation on by default). Do not pin composerRichTextEnabled to false.

Take upstream 2679d279ce (OpenCode generates its own session titles). Its titles reach personal bot threads only through personalProviderTitleAllowed: never over a manual rename, never on task/routine/group chats, and on a user-started chat only in place of the placeholder or first-message seed, once.
